column1: # Cohort spec: the two byte-proven variadic prototypes that no previous applier
# could express.  0x0055de9b sprintf and 0x0042b840 CConsole__AddString are each
# declared varargs=false while their bytes build a va_list from the argument slot
# after the last declared parameter and forward it to a formatter.  Both defects
# were already written down in their own Ghidra plate comments and never
# converted into a signature change, because every applier available at the time
# cleared varargs unconditionally and then asserted false.
# (PE parsed here: 4 sections, imageBase 00400000, .text VA 00401000 raw 00001000,
# so file offset = VA - 0x400000 for .text/.rdata/.data and .data raw ends at
# VA 00661000; .rsrc is offset by 0x774000 and is NOT flat):
# The discriminator between the two forwarders is byte-level: vsprintf at
# 0055e38c pushes the va_list POINTER it was handed ([ebp+0x10]), while sprintf
# LEAs its own frame slot - so sprintf is the variadic entry and vsprintf is not.
# THIS COHORT IS THE FIRST USER OF THE MANIFEST-DRIVEN varargs FIELD.  col.varArgs
# binds the manifest's `varargs` column; true sets it, false clears it, an empty
# cell preserves, and a spec that does not bind the column at all preserves for
# every row AND leaves varArgs frozen in the collateral census.  Nothing else
# about either function may move: name, body, comment, tags, calling convention
# and every other frozen column are gated over all 8,329 functions.
# PRE PINS ARE db.18623-ERA AND WILL GO STALE.  They were MEASURED by this
# framework's own `census` mode on a replica restored from
# off-volume backup when this spec was written.  Live moved to db.18623 the same
# day and a second tentacle ceremony was queued behind it, so a live apply MUST
# take its own fresh PRE backup and re-measure these pins first.  This spec has
# been REHEARSED ONLY; the live twin's compiled allowlist does not contain it.

column2: 2 byte-proven variadic prototypes, varargs axis only

column1: # A prototype change moves no structural metric - that is what the completed
# 294-row ceremony measured - so POST repeats PRE.  The name and body digests
# repeat too: this cohort touches neither.  postFrozenDigest is deliberately NOT
# pinned, because signatureShape and varArgs are frozen columns the two target
# rows legitimately move and the value cannot be computed outside the framework;
# the POST collateral census still compares every frozen column on all 8,329 rows.
# `constant`/`enum`/`unique` are checked against BOUND logical columns only, so a
# pin on an unbound column (confidence, changeAxes) would be silently vacuous.
# Only bound columns are pinned here.  varArgs=true is the axis this cohort exists
# for, so it is pinned rather than merely bound.
# The hazard classes the ABI cohort's GO recommendation ruled NO-GO stay out, and
# so does any silent re-typing: this cohort changes the varargs axis only.
